entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes! I need to return something NOW.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. I'm sorry to hear about the wait time. How can I help you today?
I want to return this helmet I bought. It's been nothing but a headache. My order number is VF-8675309.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up. VF-8675309... I see the Aero Road Helmet, delivered on December 6th. So you've had it for about 20 days. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? It's a piece of junk! The color is not what it looked like online, and frankly, I don't trust the safety of it. I haven't even taken it out, the box is unopened! I want my money back, and if you give me any trouble, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Get me your manager!
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can definitely look into this return for you. Please just give me one moment to review our policy for this item.
Okay, I've just confirmed our policy. For a standard item like this helmet, you're well within our 90-day return window.
Wait, really? So you'll take it back? No restocking fee or anything?

That's correct. Since you're within the 90-day period, I can process this as a standard return for a full refund. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, the refund will be issued.
Oh. Well... okay. That's what I wanted. Fine. Send the label.
I've just sent it to the email on your account. You should receive it within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
